verdict.rationale: Numeral clearly ships date-based API versions: the docs are organized under v2026-03-01, with a per-version introduction describing what the version adds, a version changelog, and a ping endpoint that returns the API version. No evidence shows a documented deprecation policy, so only half the story is covered. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, version-pinning or upgrade guidance, and independent corroboration.
